meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 生成极简的提交信息，遵循 Conventional Commits 格式。主题行尽量短（≤50 字符，硬上限 72），只在必要时添加解释原因的正文。仅输出信息，不执行 git commit。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”、“commit message”等要求，或调用 /caveman-commit 时触发；有暂存更改时也会自动触发。

say.note: 触发技能，生成极简提交信息。

say.text: 这次的改动写个简短提交
say.note: 生成主题行短、必要时带正文的提交信息。

howto.what_en: Generates terse, exact commit messages following Conventional Commits. Subject line kept short (≤50 chars, hard cap 72), body added only when needed to explain the 'why'. Only outputs the message, does not run git commit.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'write a commit', 'commit message', etc., or invoke /caveman-commit. Also auto-triggers when changes are staged.

say_en.text: Write a commit message for me
say_en.note: Triggers the skill to generate a concise commit.

say_en.text: Use /caveman-commit to generate a commit message
say_en.note: Calls the skill, following the rules.

say_en.text: Write a short commit for this change
say_en.note: Generates a commit with short subject and body as needed.
